messages:
olga: noticing postdeploy synth noise for recommendation-route in us-west after today's window. p95 up ~600ms and a few 503s from the smoke probe. @kevin can you eyeball?

kevin: which release/tag? I'll pull trace & deploy events.

olga: release=rec-service-3.4.0, region=us-west-2, canary=5% (rollout bot shows canary started at 1841007700). quick repro: `curl -s -X POST https://usw2.recommend.redwood/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{\"user\":123}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"` -> HTTP:503, body {\"err\":\"upstream_unavailable\"}.

deploy-bot: rollout: rec-service-3.4.0 -> us-west-2 (canary=5%) at 1841007700. initial probes OK.

kevin: tracing shows gateway attempts to backend, then intermittent 502/504s. model-proxy logs have repeated `prefill: stalled on kv-warmup` messages and connection resets.

olga: similar to previous warmstart issues. We should avoid incremental canary growth until repro. propose: pause rollout, pin region to previous version rec-service-3.3.9.

nora: +1 from SRE. Also recommend temporarily extending the prefill timeout to reduce false positives.

ops-bot: incident INC-7900 created: "rec-service synth 503s us-west-2" assigned to kevin, olga.

kevin: applying route pin to rec-service-3.3.9 for us-west-2. Will also set smoke threshold lower.

olga: adding short note to release notes: "us-west-2 canary paused for rec-service-3.4.0 due to synthetic prefill stalls; investigation ongoing."

kevin: pin applied, canary traffic routed back to 3.3.9. smoke probe green.

olga: leaving rollout paused. prefer pin+hotfix vs full rollback. infra to repro warmstart path with the 3.4.0 artifacts.

ops-bot: reminder: follow runbook for canary pins: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins

nora: scheduling a quick postmortem slot on infra channel in 45m.

kevin: will post repro logs and kernel selection trace in this thread when ready.

olga: thanks team. CC'ing product for visibility.
